_comment: Full reference config. Copy what you need into config.json. Keys starting with _ are documentation only and are ignored by the script. Only github.host and github.repo are required; every other key has a working default.

github._host: (change it to org host name here) github.com for public GitHub, or your Enterprise hostname.
github._repo: Owner and name from the URL path, not the URL itself.

_defaultProfile: Name of the profile applied when no --profile flag and no PR_REVIEW_PROFILE env var is given. Remove this key to default to the baseline.

fetch._maxDiffLines: Truncate the diff at N lines. Default 800. Use 0 for unlimited.
fetch._includeDiff: Set false to fetch metadata only, without the diff.
fetch._excludePaths: REPLACES the built-in exclusion list entirely - it is not merged. The default already covers lockfiles, minified bundles, source maps, snapshots, images, dist/, build/, vendor/, node_modules/, */generated/ and protobuf output. Patterns are shell globs matched against both the full path and the bare filename. An empty array disables exclusion.

review._defaultEvent: What post submits without --event: COMMENT, APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES.
review._maxFindings: Hard cap on findings in one review. Over the cap, the highest severities are kept.
review._minSeverityToPost: Findings below this severity go in the summary body instead of becoming inline comments.
review._severityScale: Optional. Relabels the four levels. Omit to use the defaults in SKILL.md.

severityScale.label: 🔴 BLOCKER
severityScale.when: Security hole, data loss, leaked secret.

severityScale.label: 🟠 CRITICAL
severityScale.when: Logic error, unhandled failure, leak, race, broken contract.

severityScale.label: 🔵 MINOR
severityScale.when: Naming, dead code, style. Never blocks a merge alone.

review._teamRules: Conventions specific to this repository, applied on top of the language-agnostic checks in SKILL.md. This is where language-specific and house rules belong. appliesTo takes shell globs; use ["*"] for every file.

teamRules.rule: Build queries with bound parameters, never string interpolation.
Inject dependencies through the constructor so the class is testable without a container.
Use the project logger rather than console output in shipped code.

_profiles: Named overrides for teams sharing one repository. Select with --profile <name>, the PR_REVIEW_PROFILE env var, or defaultProfile above. A profile merges over the baseline key by key: objects merge, arrays replace. Anything a profile does not mention is inherited. Use teamRulesAdd to ADD rules on top of the baseline; use teamRules to replace them outright.

teamRulesAdd.rule: Every forward migration needs a tested rollback path.
A field rename or type change needs a versioned schema and a consumer migration note.
